buffs.name: Sharpened Resolve
buffs.blurb: The troops hit harder in the next games.

buffs.name: Battle Hymn
buffs.blurb: A song the whole party knows. Hits land much harder.

buffs.name: Steady Footing
buffs.blurb: The troops take less from every blow.

buffs.name: Shield Wall
buffs.blurb: Shoulder to shoulder. Very little gets through.

buffs.name: A Few Extra Minutes
buffs.blurb: Ten more seconds on every clock.

buffs.name: The Long Afternoon
buffs.blurb: Twenty-five more seconds on every clock.

buffs.name: A Whispered Tip
buffs.blurb: One hint when you are stuck.

buffs.name: Margin Notes
buffs.blurb: Two hints when you are stuck.

buffs.name: Lucky Penny
buffs.blurb: The dice lean your way a little.

buffs.name: Four-Leaf Banner
buffs.blurb: The dice lean your way, and the Lottery notices.

items.name: Practice Baton
items.flavor: Wrapped grip, no edge. Pell says it still counts.

items.name: Tempered Walking Staff
items.flavor: Two summers of oiling. It knows the way home.

items.name: Starlit Pike
items.flavor: The tip catches whatever light there is.

items.name: Quilted Vest
items.flavor: Stitched by someone who worries. Warm in the right places.

items.name: Waxed Cloak
items.flavor: Rain slides off. So do most opinions.

items.name: Lantern-Plate Mantle
items.flavor: Plates hung with tiny lanterns. Loud, bright, reassuring.

items.name: Knotted Cord
items.flavor: One knot for every promise kept.

items.name: Brass Compass
items.flavor: Points at home, whatever home turns out to be.

items.name: Moonlit Pike
items.flavor: Found at the bottom of a run nobody planned to finish.

items.name: Ladle of Ages
items.flavor: Stirred a thousand pots. Has opinions about spoons.

items.name: Dawnbreak Mantle
items.flavor: Only fits people who went out this morning.

items.name: Quiet Plate
items.flavor: Muffles every worry to a murmur.

items.name: Heart of the Haven
items.flavor: Warm to the touch. It beats a little slower than yours.

items.name: Sun-Crow Feather
items.flavor: Dropped by something that only flies at noon.
